sections.name: Brunch · Brunch Café
items: Hot or iced - Discover the captivating flavor of Peru’s “Gold of the Incas” in this exquisite latte. Made with our velvety, house-made lucuma manjar (boasting notes of maple, sweet potato, and caramel), and your choice of espresso or premium ceremonial grade matcha.

Hot or iced - Inspired by a beloved Peruvian classic, this unique latte features a rich, warming house-made syrup of anise, cinnamon, clove, aromatic fig leaves, and sweet piloncillo. Blended with your choice of espresso or premium ceremonial grade matcha for a deeply comforting, subtly spiced treat that transports you straight to the streets of Lima.

Hot or iced - Your new go-to pick-me-up! This lively, Peruvian-inspired latte features our warming ginger syrup, bringing a vibrant, zesty kick to every sip. Prepared with your choice of a bold double shot of espresso or premium ceremonial grade matcha.

Iced - Indulge in a cloud of Peruvian sunshine. This exquisite iced treat features our rich, creamy lucuma manjar expertly blended with your choice of espresso or premium ceremonial grade matcha and milk. It’s crowned with a luxurious, house-made lucuma cold foam.
Iced - The refreshing twist on your iced coffee! Starts with a base of freshly squeezed orange juice, then perfectly topped with a luxurious, airy espresso cold foam.

news.headline: Nono’s Doughnuts announces November 12 grand opening
news.body: Nono’s Doughnuts & Cafe at 2514 Bancroft Way in Berkeley announces its November 12, 2026 grand opening after a November 5 soft opening. Check the shop’s published profile for offers, hours and availability.

sourceNotes.Paku: Supplied shop profile confirms address/email and poke, inari, shave ice and drinks. Glenn explicitly requests a website pilot; needsSite is set. No phone or independently verified complete owner price list is invented.
sourceNotes.Nono: Supplied shop profile confirms address, November 5 soft opening and November 12 grand opening. No complete menu/phone/hours verified. Three distinct clips attach to this page, including Dfadd8FP4oT sent immediately after Sweet Fingers but whose caption is Nono’s.
sourceNotes.Batter: Own cupcakes page publishes daily flavors and November weekday specials without full prices. Danville’s own hours/phone and supplied email are used. Sunday Pleasant Hill-only flavors omitted; other branch appears in the information panel only.
sourceNotes.Lucuma: Own website main/brunch/dessert menus give 56 food/nonalcohol items, mostly unpriced. Ask shop is explicit. Cocktail/nightcap sections omitted. Public hola@ email is used; the supplied private email-compose screenshot is not copied.
sourceNotes.MT Music: Own website confirms Richmond address, phone/email, BBQ and karaoke; supplied profile gives Tuesday–Sunday hours. No complete priced food menu verified. Glenn’s Hot Pot placement is retained as his curated category choice.
sourceNotes.Sweet Fingers: Own current Uptown Oakland ordering menu publishes 44 entries, store hours and contact details. Own promotional film is dated; November 6 opening is not presented as an upcoming event.
sourceNotes.Khao Tiew: Supplied profile confirms address and walk-in announcement. Own Square site exposes menu categories but not a reliably retrievable current item/price list. No phone or hours invented.
sourceNotes.Duplicates: DecEKVBt1Kg was sent twice at 16:48, processed once.
sourceNotes.Noncatalog: The Apple Store marketing photos and “Leave them like this” refer to the photographed displays, not a request to change the website. No external message was sent. Salad Makers and Wiggle Rumps supplied art replaces their existing icons.
sourceNotes.Noka review: Dfcqyhzxh_9 reviews Noka Ramen. The supplied request is a film and creator-icon update; the review is available through @lisaaaaletseat and Watch without inventing a restaurant page.
sourceNotes.Foodie ordering: New Heavy Hitter tags promote @booziebrunch and @thekhaysie into the existing heavy-hitter block. Ronnie Banks and MsAshleyVee remain first; the original front 24 stay in place. All creators remain reachable.
sourceNotes.Late requests: Through 8:15 p.m.: @martiebautista’s supplied portrait and Ace King BBQ reel are added. Q-Pot’s supplied swirl exactly matches its existing logo, enlarged to fill the tile. Diamond Supply Co, Vegan Mob and Phosho Dough receive their supplied logos. Vegan Mob moves from BEASTY More eats seat 17 into Food Trucks seat 17, retaining its separate Vegan category; all other existing non-foodie seats are unchanged.
